attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) and configured a login-session resource limit of 8,192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, enforced through pam_limits in system-auth. Verified the limits apply to appworker's login sessions, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and re-verified post-restart that the appworker account, its limits config, and enforced ulimits (nofile=8192, nproc=256) all survived and remain correct.
